### A Prayer for the One Who Is Afraid of God’s Glory and Power
Author: Sophia Bricker
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-the-one-who-is-afraid-of-gods-glory-and-power.html
Passage: Ezekiel 1:26-28
Points:
- Confronting overwhelming, majestic power naturally prompts fear and trembling in human beings.
- Ezekiel fell facedown in awe and helplessness before the fiery radiance and rainbow encircling God's throne.
- The holy Lord did not abandon Ezekiel to fear, but lifted him up and gave him a prophetic calling.
- While God's sovereign holiness inspires holy awe, believers can trust that He is compassionate and good.

### Ezekiel's Vision of God
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/ezekiels-vision-god
Passage: Ezekiel 1:26
Points:
- Ezekiel’s vision reveals God's majesty within its ancient biblical context rather than modern speculative theories.
- The throne above the expanse recalls God's covenant pavement and depicts Him seated upon His divine chariot.
- The imagery emphasizes the Lord's absolute transcendence and set-apart holiness as Creator and King.
- Believers are invited to contemplate God's exalted glory, revere His sovereign will, and rejoice in His love.
